thread:
sam: noticing a weird retry loop in the Kotlin SDK sample on Android 13 emulator. background syncs -> 401 -> refresh -> 401 repeats.

toni: did you use an OkHttp Authenticator or an Interceptor?

sam: Authenticator. blocking refresh call in authenticate(). snippet:
```
class A: Authenticator {
 override fun authenticate(route: Route?, response: Response): Request? {
  val t = tokenSvc.refreshBlocking()
  return response.request.newBuilder().header("Authorization","Bearer $t").build()
 }
}
```

arjun: blocking inside authenticate can starve OkHttp threads. Also multiple callers may trigger concurrent refreshes and race.

sam: repro: run sampleapp with mock server returning 401 for first two requests then 200. saw 3 refresh calls.

toni: quick fixes: 1) dedupe inflight refresh (mutex or single-flight), 2) check if request already has latest token before retrying, 3) prefer interceptor-based async refresh or external token service.

arjun: here's a minimal Java-friendly guard: check responseCount(response) and compare header token to tokenStore.peek(); if same -> return null.
